text:
sam: spotted a debug upload to gs://shared-debug/2026-08-14/host-12.tar.gz containing a VAULT_TOKEN and a KMS-wrapped backup with embedded service account JSON. marking P0 for containment. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-718 created, paging oncall.

rachel: paste a masked grep snippet so we can scope (no raw secrets please).

sam: masked output:
```
VAULT_TOKEN=***redacted***
backup.enc (contains: KMS:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/transit-KMS-07)
/tmp/sa.json -> {"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-prod","private_key_id":"***","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n***\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

sam: bucket was set to 14d and had a few external collaborators via an org group.

ops-oncall: containment steps: 1) revoke vault accessor + revoke leases, 2) delete exposed SA key and create a new limited key, 3) rewrap backup.enc to new KMS key, 4) tighten bucket IAM and reduce lifecycle to 24h, 5) enable Vault audit JSON sink for 7d. Running now.

ops-oncall: executed vault token-revoke (accessor masked) and deleted SA key. Created new key with limited roles and stored in Vault at secret/debug/new-sa (short lease).

infra: rewrap job queued for transit-KMS-07 -> transit-KMS-08, will run in next 30m and then rotate transit-KMS-07. Also opening an IAM patch to remove broad storage roles from the debug agent service account and scope to the single bucket.

rachel: quick audit: Vault shows token activity from host-12 but only reads under secret/data/dev/ci (non-prod). KMS decrypt logs show a single decrypt from the exposed SA at upload time. No prod KV reads.

sam: good. action owners:
- revoked token + deleted SA key (ops-oncall) 12 done
- new scoped SA + stored in Vault (ops-oncall) 12 done
- rewrap/rotate transit key (infra) 12 in progress
- RBAC patch for debug-SA (infra) 12 in PR
- enable audit sinks + export logs (rachel) 12 in progress

security-bot: Linked incident page https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-718 (audit ids attached).

ops-oncall: rewrap finished. rotated transit-KMS-07 schedule created. RBAC PR merged and bucket lifecycle set to 24h with uniform access.

rachel: post-incident: okay to schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow 10:00 PT. remediation proposals: default debug agent must scrub env files and reject uploads containing VAULT_TOKEN or private_key patterns; enforce per-bucket TTL <=24h for debug buckets; add pre-upload validation webhook.

sam: +1. I'll add checklist items to the incident and close once postmortem scheduled.
